notes: Existing categories keep their ids, slugs, names, images, imageAlt, isDemo flag and current demo descriptions. Existing products are never moved.
Aliases are search vocabulary and localized labels, not synonyms that merge distinct products.
Mudu, paint bucket, basket and bag are informal market measures with no assumed conversion; listings must state an explicit metric weight or volume.
canPublish is false for NG on every restricted leaf until reviewer verification is recorded. Other countries must add their own rules before enabling those leaves.

Health & Wellness, Baby, Kids & Toys, Sports & Outdoors, Automotive & Motorcycle, Tools & Building Materials and Books & Stationery were added on 2026-11-13. Regulated leaves are not publishable; wholesale stays a purchasing mode and origin/material/style stay attributes.
Department imagery for the six added departments is intentionally absent pending approved original assets; the storefront renders its honest fallback tile.

nodes.name: Car Care & Accessories
nodes.description: Cleaning and care products, interior accessories and in-car electronics. Excludes mechanical parts, tyres and vehicle audio systems requiring professional installation.

notes: Chemical products must state hazard symbols and safe-handling information.
nodes.name: Car Care & Cleaning
nodes.description: Car shampoo, wax, polish, degreasers, microfibre cloths and washing accessories. Excludes industrial workshop chemicals and paint refinishing.

notes: Seat covers must not obstruct airbags; the seller must state airbag compatibility.
nodes.name: Car Interior Accessories
nodes.description: Seat covers, floor mats, steering covers, sunshades and organisers. Excludes in-car electronics and complete seat replacement.

nodes.name: In-Car Electronics
nodes.description: Dash cameras, reverse cameras, car chargers, phone holders and portable stereos. Excludes engine electrics and professionally installed audio systems.

nodes.name: Tools & Building Materials
nodes.description: Power tools, hand tools, construction materials and workplace safety equipment. Excludes farm tools (Agriculture & Business), kitchen appliances and industrial production machinery.

nodes.name: Power Tools
nodes.description: Electric and battery-powered drills, grinders, saws and planers. Excludes industrial production machinery and petrol-powered garden equipment.

notes: Battery platform and whether a battery or charger is included must be stated explicitly.
nodes.name: Drills & Drivers
nodes.description: Corded and cordless drills, impact drivers, hammer drills and drill bit sets. Excludes rotary hammers sold for industrial demolition and bench drills.

notes: Disc maximum speed must match the tool rating; eye and hearing protection requirements must be stated.
nodes.name: Grinders & Cutters
nodes.description: Angle grinders, bench grinders, cut-off machines and cutting discs. Excludes industrial fixed machinery and welding equipment.

nodes.name: Saws & Planers
nodes.description: Circular saws, jigsaws, mitre saws, reciprocating saws and planers. Excludes chainsaws and industrial sawmill equipment.

nodes.name: Hand Tools
nodes.description: Spanners, sockets, hammers, measuring tools and screwdrivers. Excludes power tools, farm hand tools and automotive diagnostic equipment.

nodes.name: Spanners & Socket Sets
nodes.description: Combination spanners, socket sets, adjustable wrenches, torque wrenches and pliers sets. Excludes power tools and plumbing-specific tools.

nodes.name: Hammers & Measuring Tools
nodes.description: Hammers, mallets, tape measures, spirit levels, squares and screwdriver sets. Excludes power tools and precision laboratory instruments.

nodes.name: Building Materials
nodes.description: Cement, aggregates, roofing, timber, paint, plumbing and electrical installation materials. Excludes complete buildings, professional installation labour and industrial plant.

notes: Delivery cost and area are quoted by the seller; the listing must state the exact quantity and unit. No automatic truckload conversion is assumed.
nodes.name: Cement, Blocks & Aggregates
nodes.description: Cement bags, sand, gravel, crushed stone and blocks sold in bulk or by truckload. Excludes decorative stone and ready-mix concrete requiring plant delivery.

nodes.name: Roofing, Timber & Boards
nodes.description: Roofing sheets, timber, plywood, ceiling boards and roofing accessories. Excludes structural steel beams and complete roofing installation.

notes: Chemical products must state hazard symbols, ventilation guidance and safe disposal.
nodes.name: Paints & Coatings
nodes.description: Emulsion and gloss wall paint, primers, undercoats, varnish and wood stain. Excludes automotive refinishing paint and artist materials.

notes: Potable-water applications require the seller to state food-grade suitability.
nodes.name: Plumbing & Fittings
nodes.description: PVC and PPR pipes, taps, valves, connectors and cistern fittings. Excludes complete sanitaryware suites and professional installation.

countryRules.note: Fixed-installation electrical materials are safety-critical and subject to standards certification. Publishing in Nigeria requires reviewer verification of the standards marking; this leaf is not publishable until that review is recorded.

notes: Restricted leaf: canPublish is false for NG. Unmarked or undersized cable is not permitted.
nodes.name: Electrical Installation Materials
nodes.description: Electrical cable, conduits, distribution boards, sockets and switches for fixed installation. Excludes generators, solar systems and consumer electronics.

nodes.name: Workplace Safety
nodes.description: Personal protective equipment and site safety supplies. Excludes fire-fighting systems and medical first-aid supplies.

notes: PPE listings must state the protection standard and size; decorative clothing is not PPE.
nodes.name: PPE & Workwear
nodes.description: Safety gloves, safety boots, hard hats, reflective vests, goggles and hearing protection. Excludes fashion clothing and motorcycle riding gear.

nodes.name: Books & Stationery
nodes.description: Physical books, paper, writing supplies, office consumables and art materials. Excludes digital subscriptions, software licences, school uniforms and furniture.

nodes.name: Books
nodes.description: Printed textbooks, fiction, religious books and children's books. Excludes e-books, audiobook subscriptions and magazines sold as advertising space.

notes: Used textbooks must disclose highlighting, missing pages and cover damage.
nodes.name: Textbooks & Education
nodes.description: Primary, secondary, university and professional textbooks, workbooks and revision guides. Excludes past examination papers sold by unauthorised providers and digital course access.

nodes.name: Fiction & Literature
nodes.description: Novels, poetry, short-story collections, plays and literary criticism. Excludes textbooks and children's picture books.

nodes.name: Religious & Inspirational Books
nodes.description: Bibles, Qur'ans, devotionals and inspirational titles. Excludes religious artefacts, apparel and audio subscriptions.

nodes.name: Children's Books
nodes.description: Picture books, early readers, storybooks and activity books for children. Excludes school textbooks and toys.

nodes.name: Stationery & Office
nodes.description: Paper products, writing instruments, office consumables and printer supplies. Excludes furniture, printers and software.

nodes.name: Notebooks & Paper
nodes.description: Exercise books, notebooks, printing paper, notepads and envelopes. Excludes books and paper towels.

nodes.name: Writing & Drawing Instruments
nodes.description: Pens, pencils, markers, highlighters, rulers and geometry sets. Excludes printer ink, art paint and office machines.

nodes.name: Office & School Supplies
nodes.description: Staplers, scissors, glue, files, folders, calculators and desk organisers. Excludes furniture, computers and cleaning products.

notes: Compatible and refilled cartridges must be identified as such; no counterfeit original branding.
nodes.name: Printer Ink & Toner
nodes.description: Ink cartridges, toner cartridges and refill kits for home and office printers. Excludes printers, paper and photocopiers.

nodes.name: Art & Craft
nodes.description: Art materials and craft supplies for drawing, painting and handmade work. Excludes dressmaking fabric and industrial equipment.

nodes.name: Art Supplies
nodes.description: Acrylic and watercolour paint, brushes, canvas, sketchbooks and drawing media. Excludes wall paint and industrial coatings.

nodes.name: Craft Materials
nodes.description: Beads, craft glue, felt, ribbon and handmade-project supplies. Excludes dressmaking fabric, tools and finished jewellery.
